title: A homogeneous varifold v(M,θ) with tangent planes on M is invariant under dilations
statement: Let C be an n-varifold on ℝ^N, M ⊆ ℝ^N and θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with IsVarifoldOf C M θ. Suppose every x ∈ M has a tangent plane T with multiplicity θ(x), and C(A) = ∫ over {x ∈ M : ∃ T, HasTangentPlane C x T (θ x) ∧ (x,T) ∈ A} of θ dH^n for every Borel A. Suppose also μ_C(sA) = s^n μ_C(A) for all s > 0 and A ⊆ ℝ^N. Then η_{0,s#}C = C for every s > 0, i.e. rescaledMeasure C 0 s = C.measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), IsVarifoldOf C M θ → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane C x T (θ x)) → (∀ A : Set (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n), MeasurableSet A → C.measure A = ∫⁻ x in {x | x ∈ M ∧ ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane C x T (θ x) ∧ (x, T) ∈ A}, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ (s : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 < s → C.weight (s • A) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * C.weight A) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → rescaledMeasure C 0 s = C.measure
